papers.title: A Novel Approach Toward Predicting Geometric Deviations in Additively Manufactured TPMS Lattice Structures Using Conditional Generative Adversarial Networks
papers.venue: International Journal of Precision Engineering and Manufacturing

llm.relevance_to_user: 该文用条件GAN预测TPMS点阵结构的几何偏差，属于增材制造几何精度控制，可迁移到生物医学多孔植入体的制造质量控制。
llm.why_not_core: The paper does not address stress shielding, stiffness matching, fatigue behavior, or osseointegration, and it lacks any biomedical implant context or mechanical testing of porous structures.

summary_zh.motivation: 增材制造TPMS点阵结构存在几何偏差，影响性能预测与质量控制。
summary_zh.method: 构建条件生成对抗网络，以设计参数为条件预测TPMS点阵的几何偏差分布。
summary_zh.result: 模型能够生成与真实偏差分布相近的预测结果，实现几何偏差的快速预估。
summary_zh.validation: 基于增材制造样件的几何测量数据进行数值对比验证。

summary_en.motivation: Geometric deviations in additively manufactured TPMS lattices degrade their mechanical performance and complicate quality assurance.
summary_en.method: A conditional generative adversarial network is trained to predict spatial geometric deviation fields of TPMS lattice structures conditioned on design parameters.
summary_en.result: The model reproduces the statistical distribution of measured deviations and enables rapid deviation prediction without repeated metrology.
summary_en.validation: Predictions are compared against measured geometric data from additively manufactured lattice specimens.

papers.title: Mechanical characterization of constrained soft materials
papers.abstract: Soft materials such as gels and elastomers have widespread applications in robotics, biomedical engineering, and the food industry. Traditional mechanical characterization methods such as uniaxial tension/compression and rheometry cannot work in-operando or track the internal stress build-up and geometric changes of the materials due to environmental stimuli. Vibration-based methods with non-contact sensing techniques can achieve high-throughput measuring to monitor the evolution of mechanical properties and internal stresses of soft materials. However, vibration characteristics depend not only on mechanical properties and internal stresses, but also on the geometry of the samples and boundary conditions. This work demonstrates the use of nonlinear vibrations to simultaneously identify the geometry, mechanical properties, and internal stresses of constrained soft structures. This novel mechanical characterization method utilizes nonlinear transient vibrations and the corresponding amplitude-dependent frequency (backbone) curves. The method is demonstrated on clamped PDMS and gelatin disks. Linear and nonlinear vibration tests (frequency sweeps and nonlinear resonance decay) via laser vibrometry are performed on the disks and vibration characteristics are obtained; e.g., modal frequencies and stiffening coefficients due to nonlinear kinematics. These experimental vibration characteristics, when fitted with an FE model, deliver the thicknesses, Young's moduli, and internal stresses of the disks. For experimental fitting, a global surrogate model-based optimization algorithm is used. The proposed method successfully monitors the dehydration-induced changes in internal stresses as well as thicknesses and constitutive properties of the gelatin disks. The use of nonlinear stiffening responses facilitates the unique mechanical characterization of the disks and eliminates the need for independent monitoring of the full sample geometry. Potential applications of the method will be in the continuous high-throughput monitoring of bioactuators, engineered tissues, and products in the biofabrication and food industry.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文提出基于非线性振动与代理模型优化的软材料力学表征方法，可迁移至生物打印中实时监测打印结构的力学性能与内应力。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not integrate AI/ML into a bioprinting workflow stage, nor does it involve bioprinting processes, bioinks, or autonomous decision-making in biofabrication.

summary_zh.motivation: 传统力学表征无法原位监测软材料内应力和几何变化。
summary_zh.method: 利用非线性瞬态振动和幅值依赖频率曲线，结合激光测振与代理模型优化反演参数。
summary_zh.result: 成功识别PDMS和明胶圆盘的厚度、杨氏模量及内应力，并监测脱水过程。
summary_zh.validation: 对PDMS和明胶圆盘进行线性/非线性振动实验，并与有限元模型拟合验证。

summary_en.motivation: Conventional mechanical characterization methods cannot monitor internal stress and geometric changes of soft materials in operando.
summary_en.method: Nonlinear transient vibrations and amplitude-dependent backbone curves are used with laser vibrometry and a global surrogate model-based optimization to identify geometry, mechanical properties, and internal stresses of constrained soft disks.
summary_en.result: The method successfully determined thickness, Young's modulus, and internal stresses of clamped PDMS and gelatin disks, and tracked dehydration-induced changes.
summary_en.validation: Experimental vibration tests on PDMS and gelatin disks were fitted with an FE model to validate the characterization approach.
